options.name: rbdCache
options.description: Enable caching for RADOS Block Device (RBD).

options.name: rbdCacheMaxDirty
options.description: The dirty limit in bytes at which the cache triggers write-back. If 0, uses write-through caching. Constraint: Must be less than rbd cache size.

options.name: rbdCacheMaxDirtyAge
options.description: The number of seconds dirty data is in the cache before writeback starts.

options.name: rbdCacheSize
options.description: The RBD cache size in bytes.

options.name: rbdCacheTargetDirty
options.description: The dirty target before the cache begins writing data to the data storage. Does not block writes to the cache. Constraint: Must be less than rbd cache max dirty.

options.name: rbdCacheWritethroughUntilFlush
options.description: Start out in write-through mode, and switch to write-back after the first flush request is received.

options.name: rbdReadaheadDisableAfterBytes
options.description: After this many bytes have been read from an RBD image, read-ahead is disabled for that image until it is closed. If zero, read-ahead stays enabled.

options.name: rbdReadaheadMaxBytes
options.description: Maximum size of a read-ahead request. If zero, read-ahead is disabled.

options.name: rbdReadaheadTriggerRequests
options.description: Number of sequential read requests necessary to trigger read-ahead.

options.name: setupState
options.description: Flag to keep track of the installation state

options.description: The state the resource should have
